name: TikTok Publisher Branch (snippet)
description: 3 nodes thay the node LinkedIn cu trong Publisher Agent. Copy-paste vao N8N (Ctrl+V) sau khi xoa node 'Create a post' cu.
_setup_notes: 1. Tao credential moi trong N8N: Settings -> Credentials -> Add 'Header Auth'
Lay access token tu: https://developers.tiktok.com/ -> Your App -> User Access Token (OAuth scope: video.publish + photo.publish)
2. Trong cac node duoi, replace TIKTOK_HEADER_AUTH_CRED_ID bang credential ID moi tao
3. Connect: 'Telegram - Doi duyet2' (approval gate) -> 'TikTok Init Post' -> 'Wait Process' -> 'TikTok Check Status' -> 'Cap nhat Sheet Analytics4'

nodes.name: TikTok Init Post
nodes.notes: PULL_FROM_URL: TikTok server fetch anh tu URL Google Drive (img_tiktok). URL phai public, jpeg/png, <= 20MB, 200x200 - 10000x10000. Response: data.publish_id

nodes.name: TikTok Wait Process
nodes.notes: TikTok can ~5-10s de process anh sau khi init. Doi 8s truoc khi check status.

nodes.name: TikTok Check Status
nodes.notes: Response: data.status = PROCESSING / PUBLISH_COMPLETE / FAILED. Neu PROCESSING, them If node + loop wait. Neu PUBLISH_COMPLETE: data.publicaly_available_post_id.

sheet_logging_expression_changes._note: Trong node 'Cap nhat Sheet Analytics4' va 'Cap nhat Sheet Analytics5', column 'TikTok' phai update expression:
sheet_logging_expression_changes.fallback_when_processing: ={{ $('TikTok Check Status').item.json.data.status === 'PUBLISH_COMPLETE' ? ('https://www.tiktok.com/@YOUR_USERNAME/video/' + $('TikTok Check Status').item.json.data.publicaly_available_post_id) : ('PROCESSING - publish_id: ' + $('TikTok Init Post').item.json.data.publish_id) }}
